svg.text: Clara and the First Beautiful Pokemon — p9
PLACEHOLDER · characters: clara, pip, moxie · seed: None

text.tspan: Clara kneeling down slowly, both hands open and flat on her lap,
palms up. Her mouth is a tiny O as she whispers. Pip beside her,
flame-tuft dimmed to a tiny glow. The crystal moth is still
folded in her cloak on the flower, but two violet eyes peek out
now. Characters: CLARA: 5-year-old human girl, short and round,
fair white skin with pink cheeks, long honey-blonde hair to mid-
back with straight-across blunt bangs, huge sparkling blue eyes,
big tooth-gap grin, glittery pink hair bow on the right side,
red and white pokeball-print hoodie, denim shorts, red sneakers,
sticky-berry satchel across chest, big-eyed bright Pokemon-anime
cel-shaded style, default expression is a giant bossy smile with
one hand on hip | PIP: tiny round fire-mouse pokemon, fluffball
the size of Clara's hand, soft cream-orange fur with cream
belly, huge round black sparkle eyes, bright orange flame-tuft
